subproblem.title: Mass localization for a current vanishing away from a compact set (step 4(a))
subproblem.statement: Let P, k ∈ ℕ, U, V, C ⊆ ℝ^P with C compact, V open and C ⊆ V, and let X ∈ 𝒟_k(U) satisfy X(ω) = 0 for every ω ∈ 𝒟^k(U) whose topological support is disjoint from C. Then M_G(X) ≤ M_V(X) for every set G ⊆ ℝ^P (M_G = SimonGMT massOn with the Euclidean coefficient norm).
subproblem.lean_statement: ∀ (P k : ℕ) (U V C : Set (Euclid P)) (X : GeometricCurrentOn U k), IsCompact C → IsOpen V → C ⊆ V → (∀ ω : TestFormOn U k, Disjoint (tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) k)) C → X ω = 0) → ∀ G : Set (Euclid P), X.massOn G ≤ X.massOn V
subproblem.natural_proof:
Source: parent proof, step 4(a) (“the closed set {ψ = s} is a compact subset of W₀. Choose χ ∈ C_c^∞(W₀; [0, 1]) with χ = 1 near {ψ = s}. For any open G and any ω admissible for M_G, (1 − χ)ω vanishes near {ψ = s}, so P_{j,s}(ω) = P_{j,s}(χω) ≤ M_{W₀}(P_{j,s}) (χω is admissible for M_{W₀}). Hence M_G(P_{j,s}) ≤ M_{W₀}(P_{j,s}) for every open G”), stated for an arbitrary current X, compact set C (= {ψ = s}) and open set V (= W₀); the argument works for every G.

Notation: |α| is the Euclidean coefficient norm of a k-covector (SimonGMT covectorEuclideanNorm); ω is admissible for M_G if ω ∈ 𝒟^k(U), tsupport ω ⊆ G and |ω(x)| ≤ 1 for all x; M_G(X) is the supremum of ofReal(X(ω)) over admissible ω.

1. Case C = ∅. Every test form has support disjoint from ∅, so X(ω) = 0 for all ω; every term of the supremum defining M_G(X) is ofReal(0) = 0, so M_G(X) = 0 ≤ M_V(X).
2. Assume C ≠ ∅. Choose δ > 0 with {x : dist(x, C) ≤ δ} ⊆ V (IsCompact.exists_cthickening_subset_open) and let V′ := {x : dist(x, C) < δ/2}. V′ is open, C ⊆ V′, and closure(V′) ⊆ {x : dist(x, C) ≤ δ/2}, a compact set (closed thickening of a compact set) contained in V.
3. A smooth cut-off. Take g ∈ C^∞(ℝ^P) with values in [0, 1] and {g ≠ 0} = V′ (Mathlib IsOpen.exists_contDiff_support_eq). g is continuous and positive on the nonempty compact set C ⊆ V′, so a := min_C g > 0 (IsCompact.exists_isMinOn). Let τ := Real.smoothTransition (smooth, 0 ≤ τ ≤ 1, τ = 0 on (−∞, 0], τ = 1 on [1, ∞)) and χ(x) := τ(2g(x)/a). Then χ is smooth and 0 ≤ χ ≤ 1. On the open set N := {g > a/2} ⊇ C we have 2g/a > 1, so χ = 1 on N. Where g = 0 we have χ = τ(0) = 0, so {χ ≠ 0} ⊆ V′; hence tsupport χ ⊆ closure(V′) ⊆ V and χ has compact support.
4. Scaling of the norm. For c ∈ ℝ and a k-covector α, |cα| = |c|·|α|: the coefficients of cα on the increasing coordinate tuples are c times those of α, so the sum of their squares is c² times that of α, and √(c²s) = |c|√s.
5. Let ω be admissible for M_G and put ω₁ := χω, ω₂ := ω − ω₁ = (1 − χ)ω. ω₁ is smooth (product of smooth maps) and tsupport ω₁ ⊆ tsupport ω ∩ tsupport χ; hence ω₁ has compact support contained in U, i.e. ω₁ ∈ 𝒟^k(U), and tsupport ω₁ ⊆ V. By step 4, |ω₁(x)| = χ(x)|ω(x)| ≤ 1. So ω₁ is admissible for M_V and ofReal(X(ω₁)) ≤ M_V(X).
6. ω₂ ∈ 𝒟^k(U) vanishes on the open set N, because χ = 1 there. Every point of C has the neighbourhood N on which ω₂ ≡ 0, so no point of C lies in tsupport ω₂ = closure{ω₂ ≠ 0}; i.e. tsupport ω₂ is disjoint from C, and the hypothesis gives X(ω₂) = 0. By linearity X(ω) = X(ω₁) + X(ω₂) = X(ω₁), hence ofReal(X(ω)) ≤ M_V(X).
7. Taking the supremum over all admissible ω gives M_G(X) ≤ M_V(X). ∎

Remark (how the parent uses the child; not part of the proof). With X := P_{j,s} = ∂A_t − B_t (slicing sibling, f = −ψ, t = −s), C := {ψ = s} (compact, contained in W₀ for s ∈ (0, 1)), V := W₀: the slicing sibling gives P_{j,s}(η) = 0 when tsupport η ∩ {ψ = s} = ∅, so M_G(P_{j,s}) ≤ M_{W₀}(P_{j,s}) for all G, in particular M(P_{j,s}) = M_U(P_{j,s}) ≤ M_{W₀}(P_{j,s}).

Appendix (verified Lean realization of the numbered proof above; not part of the proof). The declaration below was compiled in this decomposition session with Lean v4.35.0-rc3, Mathlib 25730c7c and SimonGMT 2b366308, placed after `import GMT.Ch07.Submission` in the child comparator scope (inside `namespace GMT.Ch07` with the frozen contract's `open` commands, after its `noncomputable section ... end`). `exact Submission.lcmp_massOn_le_of_vanish_off_compact` closes the frozen type, and `#print axioms` reports only propext, Classical.choice and Quot.sound.

```lean
theorem Submission.lcmp_massOn_le_of_vanish_off_compact : ∀ (P k : ℕ) (U V C : Set (Euclid P)) (X : GeometricCurrentOn U k), IsCompact C → IsOpen V → C ⊆ V → (∀ ω : TestFormOn U k, Disjoint (tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) k)) C → X ω = 0) → ∀ G : Set (Euclid P), X.massOn G ≤ X.massOn V := by
  intro P k U V C X hC hV hCV hvan G
  have hsmul : ∀ (c : ℝ) (α : Covector (Euclid P) k),
      covectorEuclideanNorm (c • α) = |c| * covectorEuclideanNorm α := by
    intro c α
    unfold covectorEuclideanNorm
    have hsum : (∑ I : Fin k → Fin P, if StrictMono I then
        ((c • α) (fun i ↦ EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin P) ℝ (I i))) ^ 2 else 0) =
        c ^ 2 * ∑ I : Fin k → Fin P, if StrictMono I then
          (α (fun i ↦ EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin P) ℝ (I i))) ^ 2 else 0 := by
      rw [Finset.mul_sum]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun I _ => ?_
      split_ifs
      · rw [ContinuousAlternatingMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
        ring
      · simp
    rw [hsum, Real.sqrt_mul (sq_nonneg c), Real.sqrt_sq_eq_abs]
  rcases C.eq_empty_or_nonempty with rfl | hCne
  · refine sSup_le ?_
    rintro r ⟨ω, -, rfl⟩
    show ENNReal.ofReal (X ω) ≤ X.massOn V
    rw [hvan ω (disjoint_empty _), ENNReal.ofReal_zero]
    exact zero_le
  -- a smooth cut-off χ with χ = 1 near C and tsupport χ ⊆ V
  obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hδV⟩ := hC.exists_cthickening_subset_open hV hCV
  have hV'o : IsOpen (thickening (δ / 2) C) := isOpen_thickening
  obtain ⟨g, hgsupp, hgsmooth, hgrange⟩ := hV'o.exists_contDiff_support_eq (n := (⊤ : ℕ∞))
  have hgnn : ∀ x, 0 ≤ g x := fun x => (hgrange ⟨x, rfl⟩).1
  have hgpos : ∀ x ∈ C, 0 < g x := by
    intro x hx
    have hxs : x ∈ support g := by
      rw [hgsupp]
      exact self_subset_thickening (half_pos hδ) C hx
    exact lt_of_le_of_ne (hgnn x) (Ne.symm hxs)
  obtain ⟨x₀, hx₀C, hx₀min⟩ := hC.exists_isMinOn hCne hgsmooth.continuous.continuousOn
  set a := g x₀ with ha_def
  have ha : 0 < a := hgpos x₀ hx₀C
  set χ : Euclid P → ℝ := fun x => Real.smoothTransition (2 * g x / a) with hχ
  have hχsmooth : ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) χ :=
    Real.smoothTransition.contDiff.comp ((contDiff_const.mul hgsmooth).div_const a)
  set N : Set (Euclid P) := {x | a / 2 < g x} with hN
  have hNo : IsOpen N := isOpen_lt continuous_const hgsmooth.continuous
  have hCN : C ⊆ N := fun x hx => by
    have h1 : a ≤ g x := hx₀min hx
    show a / 2 < g x
    linarith
  have hχN : ∀ x ∈ N, χ x = 1 := fun x hx => by
    apply Real.smoothTransition.one_of_one_le
    have hx' : a / 2 < g x := hx
    rw [le_div_iff₀ ha]
    linarith
  have hχsupp : support χ ⊆ thickening (δ / 2) C := by
    intro x hx
    by_contra h
    rw [← hgsupp, mem_support, not_not] at h
    apply hx
    show Real.smoothTransition (2 * g x / a) = 0
    rw [h, mul_zero, zero_div]
    exact Real.smoothTransition.zero_of_nonpos le_rfl
  have hclχ : tsupport χ ⊆ cthickening (δ / 2) C :=
    (closure_mono hχsupp).trans (closure_thickening_subset_cthickening _ _)
  have htχ : tsupport χ ⊆ V :=
    hclχ.trans ((cthickening_mono (half_le_self hδ.le) C).trans hδV)
  have hχcpt : HasCompactSupport χ := hC.cthickening.of_isClosed_subset (isClosed_tsupport _) hclχ
  -- localization
  refine sSup_le ?_
  rintro r ⟨ω, hω, rfl⟩
  show ENNReal.ofReal (X ω) ≤ X.massOn V
  have hωt : IsTestForm (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) k) := ω.property.1
  obtain ⟨ω₁f, hω₁f⟩ : ∃ g : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) k,
      g = fun x => χ x • (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) k) x := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hω₁smooth : IsSmoothForm ω₁f := by
    rw [hω₁f]
    exact hχsmooth.smul hωt.1
  have hω₁supp : tsupport ω₁f ⊆ tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) k) := by
    rw [hω₁f]
    exact tsupport_smul_subset_right _ _
  have hω₁suppχ : tsupport ω₁f ⊆ tsupport χ := by
    rw [hω₁f]
    exact tsupport_smul_subset_left _ _
  have hω₁cpt : HasCompactSupport ω₁f :=
    IsCompact.of_isClosed_subset hωt.2 (isClosed_tsupport _) hω₁supp
  let ω₁ : TestFormOn U k := ⟨ω₁f, ⟨hω₁smooth, hω₁cpt⟩, hω₁supp.trans ω.property.2⟩
  have hω₂van : X (ω - ω₁) = 0 := by
    apply hvan
    rw [Set.disjoint_left]
    intro x hx hxC
    have hzero : ∀ y ∈ N, ((ω - ω₁ : TestFormOn U k) : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) k) y = 0 := by
      intro y hy
      have hco : ((ω - ω₁ : TestFormOn U k) : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) k) y =
          (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) k) y - ω₁f y := rfl
      rw [hco, hω₁f]
      beta_reduce
      rw [hχN y hy, one_smul, sub_self]
    have hxN : x ∈ N := hCN hxC
    have hnot : x ∉ tsupport ((ω - ω₁ : TestFormOn U k) : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) k) := by
      rw [notMem_tsupport_iff_eventuallyEq]
      filter_upwards [hNo.mem_nhds hxN] with y hy
      exact hzero y hy
    exact hnot hx
  have hsplit : X ω = X ω₁ := by
    have : X (ω - ω₁) = X ω - X ω₁ := map_sub X.toCurrent ω ω₁
    linarith
  have hadm : ω₁ ∈ massAdmissibleOn U k V := by
    refine ⟨hω₁suppχ.trans htχ, fun x => ?_⟩
    have hco : (ω₁ : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) k) x = χ x • (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) k) x := by
      show ω₁f x = _
      rw [hω₁f]
    rw [hco, hsmul]
    have h0 : 0 ≤ χ x := Real.smoothTransition.nonneg _
    have h1 : χ x ≤ 1 := Real.smoothTransition.le_one _
    rw [abs_of_nonneg h0]
    have h2 := covectorEuclideanNorm_nonneg ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) k) x)
    have h3 := hω.2 x
    nlinarith
  rw [hsplit]
  exact X.le_massOn hadm
```
proof_key_steps: C = ∅: X vanishes identically, so M_G(X) = 0.
Smooth χ with 0 ≤ χ ≤ 1, χ = 1 on an open N ⊇ C and compact tsupport χ ⊆ V: χ = τ(2g/a) with {g ≠ 0} = V′ ⋐ V and a = min_C g > 0.
For ω admissible in G: (1 − χ)ω vanishes on N, so X(ω) = X(χω); χω is admissible in V since |χω| = χ|ω| ≤ 1.
Hence ofReal(X(ω)) ≤ M_V(X); take the supremum.

audit.reason: The smooth cutoff construction supplies a neighbourhood of C on which χ equals one. Multiplication preserves the test-form conditions and admissibility; the remaining form has topological support disjoint from C. The argument proves the stated inequality for arbitrary G and U.
